experiment: GPU weight layout and FP32 reader co-design
conclusion: 通常BF16の短い入力に対するdown射影には改善がある。無損失圧縮には一貫した利点がなく、常駐APIの既定には採用しない。
measurement_notes: Each timing run reports medians and quartiles of seven batches, not every individual batch.
Preliminary and final sources have their own hashes; the final sources removed an unused reader helper and added report metadata.
Temperature, GPU frequency and other application activity were not recorded. Absolute timings and some ratios vary between runs.
No full model/API, memory pressure, arbitrary shape or cache alias behavior is exercised by this benchmark.

layouts.1: 4 rows x 8 columns; coalesced SIMD reads
layouts.2: 8 rows x 32 columns; coalesced SIMD reads
layouts.3: 4 rows x 8 columns; one row per SIMD group
layouts.4: 8 rows x 32 columns; one row per SIMD group
layouts.5: 32 rows x 32 columns; one row per SIMD group

data.method: Three warmup rounds, then seven samples with rotating layout/storage order; each sample batches 5..128 projections in one command, targeting at least 30 ms based on the baseline pilot. Records median GPU and host wall time and GPU quartiles; layout preparation and lossless encoding excluded from execution time. All 65536 BF16 patterns and all real sample values are reconstructed bitwise. FP32 outputs for 1/8/9/21/69/81 tokens must match the production row-major kernels bitwise.
data.limits: Aligned real-weight submatrices, not complete model/API measurements. New layouts are benchmark-only; no production default is changed.
